A leaker from China with a track record has posted online images of what are claimed to be circuit diagrams for the next-generation iPhone 18 Pro models.

The images suggest that the new-generation A20 Pro chip may feature seven GPU cores — one more than the previous generation — and use a faster memory interface...

The images posted by Weibo user "Fried White Rice" are not of the A20 Pro chip itself, but rather illustrations showing where the chip is positioned on the underlying circuit board. Based on this, the leaker has inferred the new chip's performance and architecture, arriving at two main conclusions that discuss the likely areas of improvement.

First, the circuit diagram shows six CPU cores, in the same configuration as last year's model: two high-performance cores plus four efficiency cores. However, the efficiency cores appear to have more cache memory.

It isn't easy to infer the number of GPU cores from the limited information provided by the solder-point diagrams — six, seven or eight are all possible. Nevertheless, the leaker ultimately considers seven cores to be the most likely.

Fixed Focus Digital previously pointed out that the A20 Pro chip will deliver an 18% performance improvement over its predecessor, along with a 30% boost in power efficiency.

9to5Mac's take

The Weibo account does carry a certain degree of credibility, but this kind of indirect inference is something of a dark art. While the conclusions sound reasonable, they should not be treated as confirmed information, but merely as well-informed speculation.
